Dialogs.Dialog: Kobayakawa
Oh, a really hot guy just walked by.
...Hmm.
Wow, boring. Aren't you gonna say, 'Keep your eyes on me'？
All right, if you want me to say it...
No way. It wouldn't suit you at all, so don't bother.
(Make up your mind...)
Kobayakawa
Hey. What would you do if some bad guy suddenly attacked me right now？
Put my body on the line to protect you, obviously!
Smack!
Ow! What was that for？
Game over. You need to level up more.
Kobayakawa
Oh! A cat just turned that corner.
You really love cats, huh？ They're not that rare.
...Even when it's the size of a grown adult？
Wait... Was that really a cat？
Kobayakawa
W-Whoa, close one!
Eh！？
Ah...
What is it？ What happened？
Step off the white line and you're out. Didn't you play that when you were little？
(What is she, in grade school...？)
Kobayakawa
Oh, hey, see that old building？ Is that what you call a Western mansion？
What about it？
They say a jealous girl's ghost haunts it and curses couples who walk past.
...Seriously？ Should we go around？
It's fine, I made it up. Are you actually a scaredy-cat？
Kobayakawa
I wonder where this road leads if we keep going straight.
Uh, right in front of the station, isn't it？
Be more poetic about it.
Poetic？ Uh... "It leads right to our future!"
Oh, that cloud's shaped funny...
...Hey, listen to me.
Kobayakawa
Oh... Hey, what do you think of guys who wear makeup？
Hm？ Oh, that guy... Is he in a band？
Way to jump to conclusions. Well, he does look like it.
Are you against it, ▲小早川＊▲？ Don't some of the musicians you like wear makeup？
Yeah, but... that and this are two totally different things.
Kobayakawa
Whoa, that's a big dog.
Someone your size could probably ride it, ▲小早川＊▲.
Did you say something？
I didn't say a thing.
...Think I really could ride it？
Kobayakawa
There's another couple being all lovey-dovey in public...
Whoa, you're right... Wait, what do you mean, 'another'？
I feel like I keep running into them lately. Ugh, morals really are going downhill.
So, ▲小早川＊▲, you're against being lovey-dovey in public. ...Wait, are you really？
Shut up!
Kobayakawa
Waah！
What's wrong？
It looked like that mannequin in the display window just moved...
Wait, seriously...? Does that mean...
Ugh, never mind! Come on, let's just go.
Kobayakawa
Didn't you hear a guitar just now？ Wonder if someone's practicing.
Really？ I didn't hear anything, though...
Maybe I'll try picking mine up again after all this time...
Oh right, you own one, huh.
Yeah, I just own it, though. *Sigh* Playing it'll probably just bum me out again...
Kobayakawa
A prince on a white horse, huh...
Hm？ Oh, that ad. "Meet your very own prince on a white horse." Quite the slogan, huh.
Why does it have to be a white horse, anyway？
Who knows？ Probably just because it looks cool.
Wouldn't a tiger be cooler, then？ A prince riding a white tiger.
It'd be cool, sure, but also terrifying...
Coming up on the hill soon.
Kobayakawa
When you're walking up a hill, don't you ever picture a giant boulder rolling down at you？
Your mind goes to dangerous places, as usual.
Really？ Sounds fun to me. It's pure entertainment.
(How is that fun...？)
Kobayakawa
You know how commercials always have scenes of happy couples walking around holding hands？
All right, fine. Here.
"Here" what？
Aren't we holding hands？
I didn't ask to! I mean, if you want to, I don't mind.
Kobayakawa
Ugh...
What's wrong？ That dog doesn't look all that scary, does it？
It's got the face of a dog I don't get along with. Nothing good ever happens when I go near ones like that.
(You can tell just by looking...？)
Kobayakawa
There's that dog up ahead that always barks at anyone passing by.
Yeah. It's chained up, but it always looks ready to pounce at any second.
I'm always worried that chain's gonna snap. If it does, you'll save me, right？
Yeah, leave it to me!
Thanks. Just keep it busy long enough for me to get away.
(So I'm the decoy...？)
Kobayakawa
Back when I was little, I used to think potato chips were actually leaves.
Eh？
They're shaped like leaves, right？ So I thought they just grew on trees like that...
Haha, so there'd be trees for all the different flavors.
Right, like consomme or seaweed salt. Kids sure come up with the weirdest ideas.
Kobayakawa
Someone once said that traveling is just wasted time, but going for a walk has meaning.
Hm？ What do you mean？
Getting somewhere is just about the destination. With a walk, walking itself is the point.
I see, you have a point. A walk can be fun in itself, or a nice way to take a break.
Yep, so this is a walk. Come on, talk about something fun.
Oh, a street fortune-teller. Want to give it a try？
Kobayakawa
I'm good, I'm not interested. Besides...
Hm？
Magazines and TV are one thing, but face-to-face like that, wouldn't it be better for business to only tell them good things？
Well, that might be true.
Or go the other way and stir up their anxieties to make a sale.
(She's such a realist...)
Kobayakawa
Ah, watch out.
Are you okay？ That's what you get for not watching where you're going.
A branch was sticking out, huh. I didn't notice.
Probably too busy staring at me. You need to look straight ahead when you walk.
Kobayakawa
Did you know there's a hangout for stray cats just around the corner up ahead？
Oh, really？ Are you sure you don't want to go？
I'm fine. I'd feel bad intruding, so I just watch from a distance sometimes.
Giving them their space, huh.
Yeah. It wouldn't be right to invade their privacy, would it？
Kobayakawa
Do you ever use things like dating guides for reference？
Uh... I might take a quick peek at them every now and then.
A quick peek is fine, but originality is what really matters, right？
(I'd better be careful.)
Kobayakawa
Ah... That scared me.
What's wrong？
For a second there, I thought I dropped my wallet.
That was close.
Yeah. Hey, keep an eye on me the whole time so I don't drop anything.
I don't mind, but... try being careful yourself first.
Kobayakawa
They say everyone has three look-alikes out there in the world.
You hear that a lot, but I've never actually met mine.
Still, look over there. That girl looks just like me...
What！？ Where！？
I was kidding, geez. Why'd you jump on that so fast？
(Of course I'd want to see that!)
Kobayakawa
Hey, what do you think of girls who play musical instruments？
Depends on the instrument, but it's nice. It can look graceful, or really cool.
...Right？ I think so too.
Thinking of picking one up？
...I'll pass. Tasting that kind of despair once in my life was plenty.
(It was that bad, huh...)
Kobayakawa
Lately, I feel like I've gotten worse at rock-paper-scissors.
What even makes someone good at rock-paper-scissors...
Rock, paper, scissors--!
Huh! Out of nowhere!？
...Actually, never mind. If I lose again here, I'll lose even more confidence.
Kobayakawa
I wanna get new earphones soon. Mine act up sometimes.
Have you decided what kind to get？
No, not yet. My dad knows a lot about that stuff, though...
Why not ask him, then？
No way. He knows too much, so he'll go on about it forever.
Kobayakawa
Hey, let me read your palm？
▲小早川＊▲, I didn't know you had a talent for that.
I'm self-taught. I read a library book on it, and it was pretty neat.
(That's all...？)
Yep, this line says you'll never be able to leave me. ...Hehe.
Kobayakawa
The sun rises in the east, right？ What if it rose in the west instead？
What would happen...? Wouldn't it just set in the east instead？
Well, obviously... Isn't there anything else？ It'd be a huge deal!？
Hmm, like what？
Let's see... Maybe there'd be more left-handed people!
(I kind of get it, and I kind of don't...)
Kobayakawa
When we're walking like this, it's hard to know what to talk about sometimes.
Like you have nothing to talk about with me...？
Not like that. I don't want to say something weird at random, but I'd feel bad if I stayed quiet and bored you.
▲小早川＊▲, you were thinking about something that cute？
Wha-- Shut up already. I knew I picked a bad topic.
Kobayakawa
This is kind of unfair.
What is？ Did I do something？
Walking side by side like this, you're looking down at me, right？ I don't like that.
Can't really help that. There's a height difference.
I can't accept that. Try walking on bent knees today.
(Talk about unreasonable...)
Kobayakawa
I want to fly.
...Good luck with that.
Then I wouldn't have to walk with you looking down at me. I'd look down on you from way up in the sky instead.
Can't help the height gap. ...Though then you wouldn't be able to wear a skirt, huh？
A skirt？ ......You idiot!
Kobayakawa
When it comes to meals, it's more about who you eat with than where or what, right？
Like with family, or a special someone？
Yeah. If I'm with someone special, even a family restaurant is more than enough.
Hey, don't look down on family restaurants.
Yeah, yeah. Anyway, eating out with you really isn't so bad.
Kobayakawa
Huh？ Is that a soccer ball？
Boy
Excuse me! Could you get that for me!？
All right, here it comes!!
Thanks a lot!
Huh, not bad.
Well, that was nothing.
Kobayakawa
What do you use for your phone wallpaper？
Uh... That's a secret.
Hmm, don't tell me it's a picture of me？
Who knows. Isn't yours a picture of me, ▲小早川＊▲!？
Too bad. It's a different cat photo every day.
(Darn it...)
Kobayakawa
There's danger all over the place out here.
Like what？
Falling or flying objects, getting attacked by thugs, cars and bikes...
Why bring that up？
Just wondering how much danger this boyfriend of mine can protect me from.
I'll do my best...
Kobayakawa
Oh, they're holding hands like lovers.
Oh--wait, that's two girls.
Maybe they're sisters. They seem close.
Yeah, that's sweet.
I actually like walking hand in hand with my little brother, too.
Kobayakawa
Yeah...
Sorry. I was walking a little fast.
It's fine, this is nothing.
It's fine, let's take it slow.
...Yeah.
Kobayakawa
Hey, what did the weather forecast say this morning？
Good question... Looking at the sky, I think we're still okay for now.
Hmm.
If it rains, waiting it out together wouldn't be so bad.
Yeah... that sounds nice. Actually, I wouldn't mind if it rained. Hehe.
Kobayakawa
Uh-oh... It's my homeroom teacher.
It's not like we're doing anything wrong, so who cares if we're seen？
Oh, right. Guess it was just a reflex.
(Does she get lectured that often？)
Kobayakawa
Whoa! ...Way too fast, seriously. I oughta kick 'em!
Don't glare like that. What if it's someone scary？
Like I care... Huh, didn't we have this exact conversation before？
Yeah, before we started dating. At the arcade.
Right, we did... Hehe.
Kobayakawa
What is that... a samurai？
Huh？ ...I don't see anyone.
He just turned the corner. Had a topknot and a sword.
Shooting a movie？ Though I don't see anyone else like that around...
Maybe he's a time traveler？
(No way...)
Kobayakawa
I gave J-pop a real listen for the first time in ages.
Did your tastes change？
As if. Just me trying to meet halfway for once.
Oh yeah？ How was it？
My dad recommended it, so it wasn't half bad, but the vocals... were kind of wimpy...
Kobayakawa
My folks got me a plushie from a business trip abroad.
A plushie for you, ▲小早川＊▲？ Oh, is it a cat？
Nope. A plushie that wards off evil in local folklore. No idea what animal it is, and I wake up feeling awful.
(An evil-warding plushie...)
Kobayakawa
Do you have fun going out with me？
Of course I do. Why ask that now？
Hehe, I just like to ask sometimes. A routine check.
Kobayakawa
Whoa, a magical girl. Look at that little girl.
Oh, a little dress-up set. She's even got the wand.
Mm, she's so cute. My little brother's cute, but a sister might be nice too.
Yeah, super cute. All frilly and fluttery.
...Right, I forgot. You're into little girls.
No, I'm not！
Kobayakawa
Have you heard about the 'Phantom of Towano'？
Like an urban legend？
Pretty much. They say someone in a mask and cape roams the streets.
What for...？
Who knows？ If you're lucky enough to meet them, you get a piece of candy.
(Like some old lady...)
Kobayakawa
Hey. Why do guys like lap pillows so much？
Maybe not every guy, but yeah, it's definitely something we dream about.
Hmm. The guys in my class were all hyped up about it. ...I see.
(A lap pillow from ▲小早川＊▲？ No way...)
Oh, a puddle.
Kobayakawa
When you see a puddle, don't you just wanna jump in it？
Especially as a kid, yeah.
Quit treating me like a kid！ Old man！
(That's not what I meant...)
Kobayakawa
My friend was venting about her boyfriend, saying their dates are in a rut lately.
In a rut, huh... Do you think we are, ▲小早川＊▲？
Not really. That's not necessarily a bad thing, anyway.
You think so？
It just means you're used to each other. In a way, that feels like the next stage.
I see.
Kobayakawa
That bamboo grove over there. It's always so dark. I was scared of it as a kid, so I'd always run right past it.
Oh yeah？ What about now？
Come on, I'm in high school.
Haha, yeah, fair point.
Though if it were night, I'm not so sure...
Kobayakawa
When you notice your eye level's changed, you really feel like you've grown, huh.
Yeah, the view changes.
Walls like this one, too... They felt so tall back when I was little...
(Though in ▲小早川＊▲'s case, even now...)
I can hear your inner voice, you know.
(What is she, psychic？)
Kobayakawa
...The song that person we just passed was listening to is by the Killer Bambies.
Impressive you can tell just from the sound leaking out.
Well, yeah. I'm a fan.
I bet I could recognize your voice just from the sound leaking out too, ▲小早川＊▲.
...Oh, really!
Kobayakawa
Whoa, look at that dress.
Hm, what is it？
The woman who just passed. Her dress looked like it belonged at a ball.
Huh, around here？
Yeah, it was like, total Versailles!
(Wonder what kind of event is going on...)
Kobayakawa
You end up walking a lot on dates, huh.
I know. Sometimes you wonder why you're walking around so much.
Not that I mind it or anything, though.
It's all part of the date, after all.
Yep. Well then, shall we keep moving along too？
Kobayakawa
Those black luxury cars are pretty intimidating.
Yeah, there's one parked. Screams 'company president!'
I kind of want to kick a car like that someday.
Why would you do that!?
Seems like it'd feel great, you know？ It's very anti-establishment.
(Whoa... Well, I doubt she'd actually do it for real.)
Kobayakawa
There was a lost cat poster put up back there.
Yeah... Oh, there's another one. The owner must be frantically looking for it.
I hope this little kitty makes it back to its owner safe and sound!
Kobayakawa
That baby in the stroller is really cute.
Oh, you're right. Look at that smile.
Babies are so nice... I wonder if my dad and mom will ever have another kid.
...Why don't you ask them？
Nah, I'll pass. It might just put them on the spot.
Kobayakawa
Oh, a puddle.
Whoa!?
That's what you get for spacing out.
...Aw man, my shoes got a little wet.
Being crazy about your girlfriend is nice and all, but look where you're going.
Kobayakawa
Oh, the new book is out.
Oh, the bookstore display？ That's a bestselling author. You read that stuff too？
Well, more or less. Just to keep up with what's out there.
Spoken like a true library committee member!
You're on the committee too, you know.
Kobayakawa
I wonder what that crowd's all about？
...There are cameras, too. Probably filming a TV drama or something.
I didn't know they filmed stuff like that around here.
Wanna go watch？
No, I'm good. Gawking like that is tacky.
Hara
Oh, Rinko. On a date？
Kobayakawa
...Well, something like that.
That girl just now is a friend of yours, right？
Yeah.
You were pretty short with her for a friend.
We're actually pretty close. It's just, being seen with you is a little... you know.
You were really staring at that guitar on display at the music shop earlier, huh？
Kobayakawa
Yeah, it's a God.Mt model. An exact replica of the one he actually used.
Huh, I didn't know they made those. Do you want it？
It's way too expensive. Besides, there's no point in me owning one anyway.
True, you'd have to play it.
Still, every time I pass by that shop, I'm definitely gonna stop and stare at it.
(Feels like I've heard this story somewhere before...)
Kobayakawa
Oh, another new convenience store.
There've been a lot lately. Must be because of that new apartment building. Things sure change fast...
Well, as long as it makes things more convenient, it's fine by me.
Doesn't it make you a little sad seeing your hometown change like this？
It's not like that makes my memories disappear or anything. So I don't mind.
Kobayakawa
Movers. Wonder if they're for that apartment building.
The newly built one？
Yeah. From what my parents said, a lot of young couples live in that building.
Young couples, huh. Guess there'll be lots of babies soon. Might get pretty noisy.
Ugh, dealing with crying at night sounds rough...
Kobayakawa
From my own research, it seems a lot of girls like having their heads patted.
Hmm. Takes a lot of nerve for a guy to actually do that, though.
Well, it's not like they want just anyone doing it.
True. By the way, does that include you, ▲小早川＊▲？
Who knows. I'd rather not fit into the ordinary-girl category.
(So ▲小早川＊▲ is in the special-girl category...？)
Kobayakawa
...Eek! Er, ahem...
What's wrong？
A bug just flew right in front of my eyes, that's all.
Oh, right. You're not good with bugs？
More like I hate them. And even if I didn't, having one fly right in front of me would startle anyone.
Kobayakawa
Don't you think girls are at a disadvantage？
Where'd that come from？ What's up？
Getting ready for a date takes so much time and effort. Clothes, hair, all of that...
Huh, yeah, that does sound like a lot of work!
And whose fault do you think that is!?
Kobayakawa
There's a convertible parked over there.
You're right. Wait, can't people see right inside it？
I wonder how security works on a car like that.
Plus you're at the mercy of the weather.
It looks cool, but it seems like a lot of trouble.
Kind of like a girlfriend who's cute, but a lot of trouble？
Oh, you think you're so clever, don't you!?
Kobayakawa
Being considerate to your girlfriend is best when it's so subtle she doesn't notice.
Hm？ Yeah, maybe so.
You always naturally move to the street side when we walk, don't you？
I do？ Haha, now I feel kind of bashful.
Don't let it get to your head. You failed since I noticed. Do it without me noticing.
(Complicated, huh...)
Kobayakawa
...Whoops.
Are you okay!?
I just stumbled a little. You worry too much.
That's 'cause you're not watching where you're... Whoa!
Looks like we both need to be careful.
Kobayakawa
Did you ever sing while walking when you were a kid？
Yeah, I think I did. What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
I don't remember, but they say I used to sing a lot when I was little.
Huh. Don't tell me it was punk rock back then too？
Of course not. It was nursery rhymes my mom taught me, or theme songs from anime.
Oh my...
Kobayakawa
Are you okay？ Jeez, they were going way too fast!
Hey, they'll hear you.
Yeah, well...
It's fine. ...Geez, if you get mad first, then I don't get a chance to.
Hehe, thanks.
Kobayakawa
Oh... I might've forgotten to charge my phone.
Is it about to die？ Should we find a place to charge it？
...Nah, it's fine. If it dies, it dies.
Is it really okay？
Yeah. I'm already with you, so it's not like you're gonna call me. It's fine.
Kobayakawa
That bookstore over there is closing down.
Small shops really can't compete with the big chains.
Big bookstores are handy, sure, but I kind of like the feel of small shops too...
Kobayakawa
Oh... Something smells good. Freshly baked bread, maybe.
Oh, it's a bakery van. Looks pretty popular.
With this sweet smell drifting over, I can see why it's so popular.
Want to get some？
...Hmm... There's a line, so I'll pass. Maybe next time.
Kobayakawa
A flying sneaker.
Eh？
Oh, it's just some kids kicking their shoes off.
Kids are so carefree.
Looks like fun, though.
Why don't you join in？ Even an old man wants to feel like a kid sometimes, right？
I'm only a year older than you!
Kobayakawa
Wonder what's going on. There's a crowd over there.
A big sale at the supermarket？
Oh, is that it. Still, housewives sure are intense.
You might end up a housewife someday too, ▲小早川＊▲.
...No way. At the very least, I could never jump into that crowd.
Kobayakawa
Someone's reading a book while walking. That takes skill.
Less 'skillful' and more 'dangerous,' I'd say.
I'd rather sit and read, but with how busy life is now, multitasking like that is kind of unavoidable.
You read while listening to music a lot too, ▲小早川＊▲.
That's just the basics. Later, the song reminds me of the book, or the title gets the song stuck in my head. It's pretty fun.
Kobayakawa
Did you ever have a phase where you didn't want friends seeing you with your parents？
Hmm, maybe around the end of grade school.
Wonder if that's like getting the measles or something. It goes away before you even realize it, though.
Maybe it's like the first sign of independence？
Could be. Like, 'I can make it all on my own!' Even though that's obviously not true.
Kobayakawa
That little car is cute. Isn't it British？
Yeah, true.
I don't care much about cars, but if I had to drive one, maybe something like that.
Huh. For some reason, I figured you'd go for something cooler.
It's better when they have a little charm like that. Plus, I like that it's British.
Kobayakawa
They're doing roadwork. Think we can get through？
Looks like we can, but it's pretty muddy. Want to take a detour？
It's fine, I'll watch my step. Or do you want to give me a piggyback ride？
Huh!? Well, I guess if it wouldn't embarrass you, ▲小早川＊▲...
Of course it'd be embarrassing. I was only kidding.
Kobayakawa
Apparently someone spotted a cat with a human face up the road.
A human face... Sorry, ▲小早川＊▲, but that sounds pretty creepy.
No, even I wouldn't find something like that cute...
Haha, right...
Great, now I pictured it. Creepy...
Oh, a UFO!
Kobayakawa
Yes, yes.
I'm serious! ...Wait, oh. It's just a balloon.
See？ Besides, I have bad memories of UFOs. I hate them.
Like what？
Once, during a fight with my dad, I yelled "UFO!" and threw his prized record out the window. He was furious.
(Well, obviously...)
Kobayakawa
Do you think we walk too normally together？
Normally？
Isn't there a way to walk that's more like a couple？
Hmm, like what？
Like... Figure it out yourself.
(You're the one who brought it up...)
Kobayakawa
Oh... I forgot to water Tama before I left.
Tama...？ Oh, your cactus, right？
Yeah. What if it withers...？
It's a cactus, though. Shouldn't it be fine？
Yeah, probably, but I'll call my mom just in case.
Kobayakawa
Come to think of it, haven't convenience stores been selling oden all year round lately？
Now that you mention it, nothing's really seasonal anymore.
Before long, they might start selling shaved ice in the winter.
(I doubt they'd go that far...)
Kobayakawa
Some grade-schoolers are huddled together playing games.
Do you ever play handheld games, ▲小早川＊▲？
I do, just not outside much. My portables aren't very portable.
Seriously？
Kobayakawa
Picking out cute shoes is tricky, isn't it？
It is？
Well, you have to think about practicality, too. We walk a lot on dates.
Ah, I see.
Just saying, a lot of thought goes into it.
Kobayakawa
Flyers people hand out on the street are a trap. Take one, and you've already lost.
...Are they？
I mean, what do you do if you have zero interest in it？
Throw it away, I guess.
Then it's just trash. And if there's no trash can nearby, you're stuck carrying it around. That's why I never take them.
Kobayakawa
A magazine website posted a superstition that if a couple crosses the street holding hands with their eyes shut, they'll be happy.
That's way too dangerous!
Yeah, they got complaints right away and took it down. Instead, that just gave it a weird cult following.
Guess that backfired.
I just hope it dies out before someone gets hurt.
Kobayakawa
They say there's a ghost story about a Cat Woman. Just a typical urban legend.
Huh. A woman with a cat's face？
No, the opposite. A cat walking on two legs, with the face of a gorgeous woman, apparently.
...What even is that？
Basically, it looks like a person in a cat suit who just took the headpiece off.
(Isn't that just a pretty girl in a cat suit...？)
Kobayakawa
Oh, a cat!
Aw, it ran off. Too bad.
It's fine. Having some pride is way cooler than warming up to people right away.
Is that how it works？
That's how it works. That's how a proper cat is supposed to be.
Kobayakawa
Oh, smoke...
What is that, a chimney？
Seeing something like that kind of makes you want to track down where it's from.
Oh, wanna go check it out？
...I'm good. I tried doing that once, but things like that are further than they look. You never seem to get any closer.
Kobayakawa
Do you think we look like a couple right now？
Of course we do.
Yeah, well, my friend told me we look like siblings.
Really？ Siblings our age wouldn't hang out like this, though.
That's not the point here. You just don't get it.
Kobayakawa
Getting nice weather on a date kind of makes you feel like you lucked out.
Yeah! And on laundry day!
Ugh, way to make it sound so domestic all of a sudden. I don't do my own laundry, so I wouldn't know.
Haha, you should help your mom out once in a while!
I hate letting you act like the mature one all the time, so I'll think about it.
Kobayakawa
Doesn't it seem like there's hardly any litter in Towano？ How's it compare to where you used to live？
Yeah, now that you mention it, maybe so.
Well, it's a good thing. It feels nice, and attention to the little details proves that society's systems are working the way they should.
